responsibility: This file implements GCC’s main RTL variable-tracking pass for optimized debug info. It scans each basic block into ordered micro-operations describing uses, sets, clobbers, calls, and stack adjustments; performs forward dataflow over variable-part locations and stack offsets; maintains register-to-variable reverse maps; and emits NOTE_INSN_VAR_LOCATION and related debug notes only where a variable’s location changes. It also coordinates fallback local handling and cleanup of debug insns when full tracking fails. Its responsibility is global tracking of source variable locations through optimized RTL so later DWARF generation can produce accurate location lists.
